| Usage: dashcrew release status <version> [arguments]

=== step 2: dashcrew "check" "--help"
exit: 0
stdout:
| Merge gate for a pull request: toolkit current, PR sections present, commits in the pattern. Writes nothing.
| 
| Usage: dashcrew check [arguments]
| -h, --help       Print this usage information.
| -p, --project    Project root holding .ai/project.yaml.
|                  (defaults to ".")
|     --pr-body    File holding the PR description; a pull_request workflow supplies it from the event.
|     --base       Lint the commits of <base>..HEAD; a pull_request workflow supplies the range from the event.
|     --ports      Only check that each fix of an older release line reached the newer one (exit 1 if not).
|     --from       With --ports: the older line (a version, a line branch or main); default every adjacent pair.
|     --to         With --ports: the newer line; default the line after --from.
|     --links      Only check how each dependency in project.links is committed (exit 1 if one is not merged).
| 
| Run "dashcrew help" to see global options.
stderr: (empty)
files: (unchanged)

=== step 18: dashcrew "commit" "suggest" "--ported-from" "HEAD~1"
exit: 64
stdout: (empty)
stderr:
| --ported-from HEAD~1 is not a commit hash (7 to 40 hex characters).
| 
| Usage: dashcrew commit suggest [arguments]
| -h, --help           Print this usage information.
| -p, --project        Any folder inside the repository.
|                      (defaults to ".")
|     --subject        The subject; without it the command keeps a <subject> placeholder.
|     --body           The body; without it and without --subject the command keeps a <body> placeholder.
|     --type           Override the type derived from the branch.
|     --scope          Override the scope derived from the files; an empty value drops it.
|     --ported-from    Comma-separated commits this change ports; each becomes a Ported-from: trailer.
|     --json           Print the derived parts and commands as JSON.
| 
| Run "dashcrew help" to see global options.
files: (unchanged)
